text_block_list.text: Waaah~! Hey, hey, doesn't this one-piece dress look super mature?!
Yeah, yeah! That outfit is totally marvelous for an amusement park☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Oh my? Could those voices be... maybe!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, it's Maya-chan and Mave-chan!
Are you two out shopping together?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Laurel-san!
That's right, we're looking for matching outfits
for me and Mabe-chin! The absolute most mature kind!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Going to the amusement park in matching outfits!
It's heart-pounding, thrilling, and MARVELOUS☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds like so much fun! Would it be okay
if I joined in on your shopping trip?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I copy☆ Having you with us, Laurel-san,
is gonna make it so, so much more fun!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
An aggressive purple camisole, with a top
that gives a cute peek of the shoulders, and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then how about the one with the lace sleeves over there?
I think it'd give off a sexy yet mature, cute vibe.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're right!
The whole vibe changed in an instant~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That stole over there is marvelous☆
Pairing it with a hat is marvelous★
And this one, and that one too——

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's an interesting combination.
In that case, pairing it with this innerwear
might look really wonderful too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!
A whole new horizon of marvelous☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Tail ribbons are a totally essential must-have, right?☆
A devilish style, or a mature one... hmm...
Oh well, let's just buy both!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget the scrunchies, bags, and cosmetics!
Everything good is completely marvelous☆★

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they all suit you both so well!
Though... aren't you going to have too much
to carry pretty soon?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Knowing when to call it a day is also
a step toward becoming a mature and marvelous horse girl!
Let's head home after we pick out this next one, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano & Marvelous
text_block_list.text: Okaay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I stopped by the cafeteria for a break,
Sakura Laurel and the others had clothes and accessories
spread across the table, chatting excitedly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
All right then!
Now all that's left is putting what we bought together
to create our matching outfits!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I-I mean, yeah, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano & Marvelous
text_block_list.text: Everything is too good, we can't narrow it down!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, well,
they're all things you two absolutely love, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then how about this?
Mabe-chan picks the mature items,
and Maya-chan picks the marvelous ones.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Since you'll be choosing with each other in mind,
I'm sure it'll turn out to be a truly wonderful and perfect outfit!

text_block_list.name: Mayano & Marvelous
text_block_list.text:
It's decided~!!
Mature and marvelous☆★

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes!
Those outfits are just perfect for the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~!
Thanks for the marvelous advice☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You have great fashion sense,
you're so thoughtful and kind...
You really feel like a mature big sister, Laurel-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you!
Though I think that's mostly thanks to the club members.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Back when all I could do was watch the other girls run,
and even when I pushed myself too hard and fell ill——

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Everyone stayed right by my side.
Looking after my legs... and my heart, the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's why I thought to myself:
I want to be able to help someone else,
just like everyone helped me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, you really are so mature...!
Maya wants to hurry up and become
a wonderful big sister just like you, Laurel-san~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you!
But Maya-chan, Mabe-chan, I think
the two of you are already truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You're earnest about your dreams, and always so cheerful.
Watching how straightforward you both are
gives me the courage to keep doing my best too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's an amazing thing
that only sparkling girls like you can do, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Because it's us, huh... ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: *Ahem*☆ Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their heartwarming interaction
brought a gentle warmth to everyone around them.
